<function name="SetShouldSimulate" parent="CNewParticleEffect" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets whether the particle system should continue simulation or not. If simulation is paused, all currently active particles will be frozen in place.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2025.11.26</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="simulate" type="boolean">Whether the simulation should run (`true`) or not (`false`).</arg>
	</args>
</function>
